classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round every rank hits barrier.wait() then does _read_staged on the single shared class_a file m%d for that round before the next barrier, so all ranks are held at the synchronisation point waiting on that one file, and each per-round file is read exactly once by a rank.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: After the round's barrier each rank reads its own class_b(workdir, me, i) files with a synchronous _read while other ranks independently read their own, and the same rank re-reads each of its files once per round for cell.rounds = 200 rounds.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: Each rank synchronously _reads its private class_c(workdir, me, i) files in the post-barrier section with no other rank waiting, and the loop repeats every round, giving 200 reads of each file by that rank.
